discoveries.title: Access to Real-Time Schedule and Infrastructure Data
discoveries.discovery: Customer service representatives need quick access to real-time schedule data, platform assignments, station layout details, and train-specific amenities to answer passenger enquiries.
discoveries.source_basis: The stakeholder requires real-time schedule data, platform numbers, station layout, and train amenities to perform enquiries.

discoveries.title: Access to Delay Reasons and Duration
discoveries.discovery: CSRs require the specific reason for delays and estimated durations to properly inform and advise passengers.
discoveries.source_basis: The stakeholder mentions requiring real-time status of delayed trains and crucially the reason for the delay.

discoveries.title: Single Source of Truth and Data Consistency
discoveries.discovery: Inconsistencies between the CSR system, public screens, and mobile apps erode passenger trust. A single authoritative source is required.
discoveries.source_basis: The stakeholder notes failure scenarios involving conflicting info where their system shows one thing and public screens another.
discoveries.open_question: What is the definitive authoritative source for real-time journey information?

discoveries.title: Ticketing, Refunds, and Compensation Support
discoveries.discovery: Processing refunds, issuing compensation, and handling complex ticketing or routing are outside direct CSR control and need definition regarding system inclusion.
discoveries.source_basis: The stakeholder explicitly mentions that ticketing support, direct compensation, and refunds are scope candidates or questions for future definition.
discoveries.open_question: Should SmartRail include ticketing support, refunds, and compensation management?

discoveries.title: Hotel Accommodation and Private Taxi Arrangement
discoveries.discovery: Arranging hotel accommodation or private taxis for individuals stranded by major disruptions is noted as a potential scope item or policy question.
discoveries.source_basis: The stakeholder states that arranging hotel accommodation or private taxis is a scope candidate/question.
discoveries.open_question: Are hotel and taxi arrangements part of the system or operator policy scope?

discoveries.title: System Slowdown and Downtime Impact
discoveries.discovery: System slowdowns or downtime prevent CSRs from accessing information, leading to delays and passenger frustration.
discoveries.source_basis: The stakeholder identifies system slowdown/downtime as a failure scenario where information cannot be accessed.

discoveries.title: Language Barrier and Translation Support
discoveries.discovery: Inability to communicate effectively with passengers who speak different languages without translation support.
discoveries.source_basis: The stakeholder lists language barrier as a failure scenario causing communication difficulties.
discoveries.open_question: How should language barriers be handled within the system?

discoveries.title: Real-time Facility Status Updates
discoveries.discovery: Unclear how quickly CSRs are informed about out-of-order facilities like broken lifts and whether a real-time status update system exists.
discoveries.source_basis: The stakeholder lists facility status as an unclear responsibility regarding real-time status updates.
discoveries.open_question: How are broken or out-of-order station facilities reported in real time to customer service?

discoveries.title: Dedicated Ticketing Agent
discoveries.discovery: Complex ticketing and routing issues are escalated to a dedicated ticketing agent if SmartRail does not include ticketing support.
discoveries.source_basis: Escalation paths mention a dedicated ticketing agent.

discoveries.title: Station Management, First Aid, and BTP
discoveries.discovery: Medical issues, security concerns, lost children, and unruly passengers require escalation to Station Management, First Aid, or British Transport Police.
discoveries.source_basis: Escalation paths outline medical/security and lost children handoffs to Station Management, First Aid, or BTP.

discoveries.title: Alternative Transport Activation Process
discoveries.discovery: A defined process is missing for when and how alternative transport (buses, taxis) is activated and communicated during significant delays or cancellations.
discoveries.source_basis: The stakeholder notes alternative transport activation as a missing business process.
discoveries.open_question: Who decides on and arranges replacement transport, and how is it communicated?

discoveries.title: Real-time Accessibility and Lift Status Tracking
discoveries.discovery: CSRs need real-time operational status of all accessibility equipment, such as lifts and ramps, to assist passengers with mobility needs.
discoveries.source_basis: The stakeholder highlights the need for real-time status of station accessibility features and notes out-of-date information as a failure scenario.

discoveries.title: Spontaneous and Pre-booked Assistance Protocols
discoveries.discovery: Protocols are needed for managing both pre-booked and spontaneous mobility assistance, including handling assistance no-shows.
discoveries.source_basis: The stakeholder discusses verifying pre-booked assistance, arranging spontaneous assistance, and failure scenarios like assistance no-shows.

discoveries.title: Unified Booking and Tracking Assistance System
discoveries.discovery: A unified system is desired for booking and tracking assistance requests across journeys, potentially involving multiple operators.
discoveries.source_basis: Unclear responsibilities mention an integrated booking system for assistance requests across operators.

discoveries.title: Inter-Operator Ticket Acceptance and Rules
discoveries.discovery: Rules for ticket acceptance across different operators during disruptions are often unclear and vary widely.
discoveries.source_basis: Failure scenarios and missing processes note unclear ticket acceptance rules for alternative routes or operators.
discoveries.open_question: How can inter-operator ticket validity rules be easily viewed and communicated during disruptions?

discoveries.title: Complaint Logging System
discoveries.discovery: CSRs need access to a designated system to accurately and efficiently log complaints and track escalations.
discoveries.source_basis: Information required for complaints includes access to a complaint logging system.

discoveries.title: Dynamic and Constantly Changing Estimates
discoveries.discovery: Constantly shifting arrival or departure time estimates erode passenger trust and CSR credibility.
discoveries.source_basis: Failure scenarios under delays list 'Constantly Changing Times' where estimates keep shifting.

discoveries.title: Vulnerable Passenger Support Protocol
discoveries.discovery: A defined process is needed for identifying and proactively supporting vulnerable passengers, unaccompanied minors, the elderly, or those with cognitive disabilities during major cancellations or platform changes.
discoveries.source_basis: Unclear responsibilities mention vulnerable passenger support during cancellations and specific handoff procedures.
discoveries.open_question: What are the specific handover and support protocols for vulnerable passengers?
